title: fix for bug 2174433
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index e184914..7a2bed0 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+sssd (2.12.0-4ubuntu5) tenacious; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/sssd-common.logrotate: signal all SSSD services after log rotation so
+    socket-activated responders reopen their logs (LP: #2174433)
+
+ -- Jonas Jelten <jj@ubuntu.com>  Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:50:31 +0100
+
 sssd (2.12.0-4ubuntu4) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   [ Maizi Liao ]
diff --git a/debian/sssd-common.logrotate b/debian/sssd-common.logrotate
index f305c87..8a58798 100644
--- a/debian/sssd-common.logrotate
+++ b/debian/sssd-common.logrotate
@@ -5,7 +5,9 @@
 	notifempty
 	compress
 	delaycompress
+	sharedscripts
+	su sssd sssd
 	postrotate
-		kill -HUP `cat /var/run/sssd.pid` > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
+		systemctl kill --signal=HUP --kill-whom=all 'sssd*.service' || true
 	endscript
 }
